skills: Develop and execute performance marketing strategies: Plan, implement, and optimize multi-channel campaigns (paid social, PPC, display advertising, etc.) to meet acquisition, conversion, and ROI goals.

title: Team Lead, Agency Growth Sales, SpLATAM - Mexico
description:
About the job

Responsibilities
At TikTok, our Global Business Solutions (GBS) team plays a key role in generating revenue by promoting our advertising solutions, onboarding new clients, driving ad campaigns, and more. As the TikTok community grows at an unprecedented speed around the world, our GBS team leads groundbreaking projects that are changing the landscape of the advertising industry in real time.

About the team:
TikTok's Agency Sales team is at the forefront of connecting agencies of all sizes with TikTok's creative ecosystem — helping them unlock performance, build compelling narratives for their clients, and grow sustainably on the platform. Our team operates at the intersection of business strategy, product expertise, and client partnership.

The LATAM Agency team is a high-growth, high-impact environment where no two days are the same. We move fast, think big, and win together.

About the role:
We are looking for an experienced Team Lead to head our Agency Sales function across Latin America. This is a player-coach role: you will manage and mentor a team of Agency Partner Managers while also owning strategic relationships with our most critical agency partners in the region.

You will be responsible for driving revenue growth, developing the agency ecosystem, and representing TikTok as the go-to performance and brand-building platform for agencies across Brazil & SpLATAM markets including Mexico, Colombia, Argentina. You will be a key voice in shaping regional strategy, go-to-market motions, and long-term agency enablement programs.

This role requires an experience leader with deep knowledge of the LATAM agency landscape, a proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, and the ability to inspire and develop high-performing teams in a hyper-growth environment.

In-Office Policy - We are currently working in the office 4x a week in Polanco and will be moving to full-time, 5 days in-office by September 2026.

*Please submit your resume in English in order to be considered*

Responsibilities:
1) Team Leadership & People Development
- Lead, coach, and develop a team of Agency Partner Managers across region, fostering a high-performance culture rooted in accountability, creativity, and commercial rigor.
- Set clear team objectives, track performance against KPIs, and provide structured feedback and development plans to support individual growth.
- Recruit, onboard, and retain top commercial talent as the team scales.
- Serve as a role model for consultative selling, strategic account management, and cross-functional collaboration.

2) Revenue & Business Growth
- Own and drive the team's revenue targets across the SMB agency segment in LATAM, with accountability for both top-line growth and portfolio health metrics.
- Identify, prioritize, and develop strategic agency partnerships — including independent agencies, regional networks, and in-market holding company affiliates.
- Architect and execute scaled engagement models that allow the team to grow agency revenue efficiently across a large and diverse book of business.
- Build and manage a robust pipeline of new agency acquisition opportunities, translating market trends into actionable growth strategies.

3) Agency Partnerships & Enablement
- Build deep, strategic relationships with C-level and high-level stakeholders at top agencies 
- Lead executive business reviews (QBRs) and joint business planning sessions with key agency partners to align on growth roadmaps and investment strategies.
- Develop and oversee structured agency education and certification programs, ensuring partners are fluent in TikTok product solutions, creative best practices, and full-funnel strategies.
- Champion TikTok's value proposition externally, representing the platform at industry events, agency summits, and partner forums across the region.

4) Strategy & Cross-Functional Influence
- Serve as the primary voice-of-the-market for LATAM agency insights, providing structured feedback to Product, Marketing, and Operations to shape platform priorities and scaled solutions.
- Partner closely with cross-functional teams including Global Sales Excellence, Marketing, Trust & Safety, and Ops to design and execute regional go-to-market initiatives.
- Develop data-driven strategic narratives and market analysis to inform leadership decisions and regional investment priorities.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- Years of experience in digital advertising, media sales, or agency partnerships, with at least 3 years in a team leadership or management role.
- Deep, firsthand knowledge of the LATAM agency ecosystem — including the leading independent agencies, regional holding company structures, and the key decision-makers shaping client investment across major markets.
- Demonstrated track record of exceeding revenue targets and growing complex, multi-stakeholder agency relationships in a fast-paced commercial environment.

- High written and oral proficiency in Spanish and English is required due to frequent communications with stakeholders based in Spanish-speaking markets".
- Strong command of the digital advertising ecosystem — including performance marketing, programmatic, social, and full-funnel planning — with the ability to credibly advise high-level agency leaders.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience at a social media, digital platform, or ad tech company, ideally working directly with or within agencies at a leadership level.
- Familiarity with TikTok's advertising solutions, including TikTok for Business, Shop Ads, and performance-based products.
- Knowledge of auction-based and programmatic ad products, and experience translating product complexity into commercial narratives for agency audiences.
- Experience designing and leading scaled agency enablement programs such as certification tracks, partner academies, or structured QBR frameworks.
- Strong executive presence with the ability to engage C-suite stakeholders both externally (agency partners) and internally (TikTok leadership).
- Passion for TikTok's mission and a genuine curiosity about creator culture, short-form content trends, and the evolving role of social commerce in LATAM.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

description:
About the job

Imagine yourself…


Doing meaningful work that makes an everyday impact on the world around you 
Growing your expertise and expanding your skillset with every project 
Owning your ambition and fueling your career growth 



It’s possible with a role at ChemTreat.

ChemTreat, a Veralto company, is the nation’s largest and fastest-growing specialty chemical company dedicated solely to industrial water treatment. We understand and respect the awe-inspiring power of water to impact industries, and to sustain and enhance lives. Our 2,000 associates across North and South America maximize this power for our customers—from power producers to food and beverage companies to the automotive industry—helping them grow their businesses while protecting people and the environment.

When you join the ChemTreat team and the broader Veralto network, you’ll have the chance to shape the future of our planet and the future of your career. You’ll have opportunities to build new skills and invest in your development, all while doing meaningful work that makes an everyday impact on the world’s vital water resources.

Learn more about how our team is maximizing the power of water: https://wi.st/3vH5OUK

We offer:


Competitive benefits package 
Professional onboarding and training options 
Career coaching and development opportunities 
Supportive, collaborative team environment 



Reporting to the SR Digital Marketing Manager

The Senior Inbound Marketing & Content Specialist is responsible for supporting the strategy, architecture, governance, and scalability of internal and customer-facing content across global marketing initiatives. This role focuses on producing high-quality written content that attracts, educates, and engages prospective customers while ensuring content is structured, optimized, and deployed effectively across channels to drive measurable business impact.

This position is part of the Marketing organization and will be remote in Mexico.

In this role, a typical day will look like:


Developing and delivering clear, compelling written marketing content aligned with global campaigns, brand voice, governance standards, and performance metrics such as SEO, engagement, and conversion 
Partnering with marketing, sales, and technical subject matter experts to translate complex concepts into customer-focused content aligned to buyer personas and journey stages 
Managing content deliverables from intake through production, review, and publishing while balancing multiple priorities and deadlines 
Publishing, maintaining, and updating content across marketing platforms to ensure consistency, reuse, and scalability 
Driving continuous improvement of content processes, workflows, and systems to increase efficiency and quality 
Mapping and optimizing end-to-end content workflows across people, tools, and processes 



The essential requirements of the job include:


Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, journalism, technical writing, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience 
4–7 years of experience in marketing, content, or writing-focused roles, preferably in B2B, industrial, or technical environments 
Native-level proficiency in written and spoken English demonstrated through professional writing experience 
Experience working with website content management systems and structured content workflows 
Familiarity with marketing tools such as Microsoft Office, CMS platforms, CRM or marketing automation systems, and content or digital asset management tools 



ChemTreat is proud to be a part of the Water Quality segment of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), a $5B global leader dedicated to ensuring access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. When you join Veralto’s global network, you join a culture where purpose meets possibility—where the work you do has an everyday impact and where you’ll have opportunities to grow your career while safeguarding the world’s most vital resources.

At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

Unsolicited Assistance

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.

 📍 León, Gto. | Modalidad remota/flexible | Tiempo completo




¿Por qué unirte a Pensión Perfecta?

Pensión Perfecta está en una etapa de crecimiento acelerado y buscamos un Asesor de Inversiones Senior que quiera crecer con nosotros. Ofrecemos un esquema de compensación y bonos sin tope, más competitivo que el de banca tradicional y casas de bolsa — aquí tu ingreso refleja directamente tu desempeño, sin límites artificiales.




Descripción del puesto

Como Asesor de Inversiones Senior, diseñarás y gestionarás planes de inversión personalizados para clientes que buscan optimizar la relación riesgo-beneficio manteniendo el mayor rendimiento posible. Serás una pieza clave en el crecimiento de la empresa: la captación de nueva cartera es parte central de tu día a día, junto con la creación de portafolios a la medida, el análisis financiero y el acompañamiento cercano a tus clientes.




En tu día a día:

Captarás y desarrollarás cartera de clientes como parte activa de tu gestión comercial.
Crearás portafolios de inversión personalizados para cada cliente, alineados a su perfil de riesgo y objetivos financieros.
Analizarás la situación financiera de cada cliente y definirás estrategias de inversión acordes a su perfil de riesgo.
Darás seguimiento periódico a las carteras bajo tu gestión.
Tendrás contacto directo con clientes para resolver dudas, explicar alternativas de inversión de forma clara y acompañarlos en la toma de decisiones.
Colaborarás con otros equipos para garantizar una experiencia integral al cliente.
Coordinarás reportes y documentación de operaciones.
Tu desempeño se medirá contra metas claras de captación, creación de portafolios y gestión de cartera, con el respaldo de un esquema de compensación diseñado para premiar los resultados.




Ubicación y modalidad

El puesto está adscrito al Área Metropolitana de León, Gto., pero no requiere presencia física constante: puedes desempeñarlo de forma remota, inclusive estando en otra ciudad o estado, con la flexibilidad que necesitas para maximizar tu productividad.




Requisitos

Experiencia sólida en planificación financiera y finanzas, con capacidad para analizar la situación económica de clientes y definir objetivos realistas.
Conocimientos avanzados en inversiones y estrategias de inversión, incluyendo diseño de portafolios, diversificación de carteras y gestión de riesgos.
Experiencia o habilidad comprobada en captación y desarrollo de cartera de clientes.
Aptitudes destacadas en atención al cliente, con orientación al servicio, empatía y habilidad para explicar conceptos financieros complejos de forma sencilla.
Titulación universitaria en Finanzas, Economía, Administración de Empresas o similar; se valora formación adicional en asesoría financiera o certificaciones profesionales.
Manejo competente de herramientas digitales y hojas de cálculo, así como experiencia trabajando en entornos remotos/híbridos.
Capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma, alta responsabilidad, orientación a resultados y cumplimiento de metas.




Lo que ofrecemos

Atractivo esquema de compensación y bonos sin tope, superior al de banca y casas de bolsa asegurando ingresos mayores a $100,000 desde el primer mes
Flexibilidad de ubicación: trabaja desde donde seas más productivo.
Formar parte de una empresa en fase de crecimiento acelerado, con oportunidades reales de desarrollo.

description:
About the job

Job Description

Logistics Specialist

Job Location: Mexico-Mexico City

Sound made by Sennheiser – For more than 80 years, we are among the world’s leading manufacturers of audio products, building the future of audio. We are proud of our finely engineered microphones and audio solutions that connect people and create remarkable sound experiences - whether in the studio, conference room, or on stage.

For us, the audio industry is one of the most exciting to work in. In our global family business, you can expect not only a unique team where we trust, value and support each other, but also the opportunity to make your own significant contribution to our collective progress.

Sounds good? Join us as

Logistics Specialist

We are seeking a detail-oriented and customer-focused Logistics Specialist – Order to Delivery to support the efficient movement of products, spare parts, and repair-related shipments across the end-to-end Order-to-Delivery (O2D) process. This role is responsible for coordinating logistics operations, inventory activities, import/export documentation, and transportation services to ensure timely and accurate delivery to customers.

The ideal candidate will have experience working in logistics, warehousing, inventory control, or supply chain operations and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Key Responsibilities

Logistics Operations & Distribution


Coordinate inbound and outbound logistics activities to support efficient order fulfilment and material flow.
Coordinate warehouse and inventory activities, including stock accuracy, goods movements and inventory reconciliation.
Coordinate transportation, shipment tracking and delivery execution with logistics service providers.
Prepare and maintain logistics documentation and ERP transactions to support compliant logistics operations.
Support management of demo equipment, marketing materials and designated inventory.


Import/Export & Compliance


Coordinate with all established carriers and forwarders (Fedex UPS or others) to ensure shipments have the required documents and information to enable delivery
Retain document packets for each shipment to support audits, legal requirements and duty draw back.
Coordinates necessary paperwork and documentation in compliance with tariff, certifications, and customs regulations.
Coordinate with local warehouse for prioritization of deliveries and facilitate dock availability for the forwarders as required
Enter all pertinent information on the government sites to facilitate the completion of each packet
Reverse Logistics oversight


Repair & Service Logistics


Coordinate logistics activities related to customer returns, repairs, spare parts, and service-related shipments.
Support the movement of repair units between customers, warehouses, and service centers.
Maintain accurate inventory and system records for repair-related materials and transactions.


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner closely with Customer Support, Order Management, Repair Services, Supply Chain, Finance, and Sales teams to ensure successful order fulfillment.
Provide shipment updates, inventory visibility, and logistics information to support customer service and operational decision-making.
Assist in resolving delivery issues, shipment discrepancies, and logistics-related concerns.
Participate in Order-to-Delivery reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.


Other Responsibilities


Ensure compliance with company policies, supply chain service standards and operational procedures.
Support country-specific operational requirements where applicable.
Contribute to a positive team environment and collaborative working culture.
Support onboarding and development of colleagues where required.
Undertake other duties, projects and responsibilities as reasonably assigned from time to time, consistent with the scope, responsibilities and level of the role, to support business and operational requirements.


Qualifications

Required


Fluent in English and Spanish.
Bachelor’s degree preferred
Experience using ERP systems
Knowledge of import/export processes and shipping documentation.
Minimum of 1+ years of experience in logistics, warehousing, inventory control, customer service, or a related field.
Working knowledge of shipping, transportation, and inventory management processes.
Strong organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Experience working with warehouses, carriers and/or freight forwarders
Valid driver's license.


What You Can Expect From Us


 Inspiring Work Environment: Become a part of our international family business, where a modern and dynamic work atmosphere awaits you. At Sennheiser, people and their mindset are at the heart of everything we do - they are our most valuable asset.
 Flexible Working Models: We offer flexible working hours and mobile work options to help you balance your professional and personal life.
 International Collaboration: Look forward to working in a global team collaboration and contributing to exciting projects that shape the future of audio.

Strive to meet and exceed both personal and team goals in net subscriptions while building company credibility, brand value, and trust within the assigned business channel.

Please apply uploading your resume in English. We are looking for Fluent English Speakers to work with US clients. 

Are you an intellectually curious person with a passion for solving problems for clients? Do you enjoy capturing and interpreting data using SQL for modeling?

This full-time hybrid position (after 3 months of on-site training period) is based in our Mexico City office, with flexible work options available later. The role supports multiple business areas and is an excellent opportunity to join a collaborative and high-performing team in our Global Capability Center.

What the day will look like

Aon’s Innovation and Integrated Solutions (IIS) team brings together six specialty areas—Pharmacy, Audit, Clinical/Wellbeing, Compliance & Policy Consulting, Time Away & Life Solutions, and Innovation Area.

The Health Solutions Client Success Coordinator – IIS Pharmacy will contribute to the team's success by taking ownership of and accountability for assigned client projects and deliverables. You will play an integral role on the client team.

You will collaborate colleagues based in the U.S., working with team members to turn data, insights, and ideas into clear, well‑structured strategies internally and externally!

Key Responsibilities


Proactively building knowledge base of health and welfare benefits
Developing an understanding of basic business and financial concepts
Collaborating with others to ensure accuracy and timeliness
Service client accounts, develop client project plans, and coordinate deliverables
Review pharmacy claims data and use analytical tools such as SQL Server Management Studio, SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), Tableau, and Excel to extract, transform, load, and validate significant volumes of data against business requirements
Develop data views and alerts based on analysis
Develop deep subject matter expertise in the area of pharmacy benefits, developing knowledge on best practices and market trends, and contributing to the developments and enhancement of new and existing products and services
Work with colleagues from Pharmacy Practice to bring in expertise on variety of subjects to create new, topical reports and support advising clients on how to act on their data insights
Demonstrate excellent communication skills with the ability to clearly convey technical information, including good presentation skills


Required Experience

We’re looking for collaborators, analytical professionals, problem solvers, excellent teammates, effective communicators, relationship builders and future leaders. We strive to recruit a range of hardworking individuals who offer varying experiences, backgrounds and strengths to ensure we can continue to offer the most innovative solutions. Additionally, we take into consideration the following:


English proficiency in effective communication, encompassing both verbal and written forms
Clear, concise, and professional communication skills are required
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills; able to identify problems and solutions
Exceptional interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively in a team environment
Solid research skills 
Project scheduling, coordination, and diligent follow-up skills with strong attention to detail
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Excel spreadsheets, PowerPoint, e-mail and internet tools
Basic understanding of database architecture 
Data visualization skills


How This Opportunity Is Different

What makes Aon different are the people and the culture! Aon colleagues support each other, across geographies and solution lines. Aon offers the tools along with broad and deep experience to achieve outstanding results for those we serve. We compose an efficient environment that supports our colleagues' career and personal growth

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

description:
About the job

Company Description Omica is building tools and infrastructure that empower Latin American cancer centers to lead in AI-enabled cancer care. By combining advanced technology with deep clinical focus, Omica aims to improve diagnostic accuracy, treatment planning, and patient outcomes across the region. The company collaborates closely with hospitals and oncology specialists to integrate AI solutions into real-world clinical workflows. Team members join a mission-driven environment where innovation directly supports cancer care providers and patients.
Role Description The Hospital Sales Executive is a full-time, on-site role based in Mexico City, Mexico. This role is responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities with hospitals and cancer centers, building strong relationships with key stakeholders, and driving adoption of Omica’s AI-enabled solutions. Day-to-day tasks include conducting sales meetings and product presentations, managing the sales pipeline, preparing proposals and contracts, and negotiating commercial terms. The Hospital Sales Executive will collaborate with clinical, product, and customer success teams to understand hospital needs, tailor solutions, and ensure a smooth implementation process. The role also involves tracking market trends, gathering feedback from clients, and contributing insights to refine Omica’s go-to-market strategy.
Qualifications
 
Demonstrated experience in B2B sales, preferably in healthcare, medtech, or health IT, with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets.
Strong relationship-building and account management skills, including the ability to engage hospital executives, clinical leaders, and administrative stakeholders.
Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation abilities in Spanish; professional proficiency in English is highly beneficial.
Solid understanding of hospital operations, oncology workflows, or healthcare systems; familiarity with AI, data, or digital health solutions is a plus.
Ability to manage a structured sales pipeline, use CRM tools effectively, and work with data to forecast and report on performance.
Comfort working on-site with clients, traveling within Mexico as needed, and collaborating cross-functionally in a fast-moving startup environment.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Healthcare Administration, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong problem-solving mindset, ethical and patient-centered approach, and commitment to advancing cancer care in Latin America.

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

You will play an active role in problem solving for clients including identifying issues, forming hypotheses, designing and conducting analyses, and synthesizing conclusions into recommendations.

As part of our two-year Operations Excellence Program (OEP), you will work on client engagements in the same way as any other McKinsey consultant. You will gain leading edge operations and consulting skills, primarily through on-the-job coaching which will be complemented by the OEP’s structured capability-building program. During your first few years with the firm, you will serve as a junior practice specialist on multiple client engagements and work with several colleagues and clients in a range of industry and operations service lines. You will acquire the necessary knowledge and expertise to help companies achieve excellence in their operations.

Along with other members of the OEP community, you will dedicate many days to functional training and knowledge development under the leadership of our operations experts. You will follow a curriculum based on operations excellence themes and will receive advanced training in specific areas of operations.

Additionally, you will engage with our clients to create new strategies across a wide range of projects, from automation to mine optimization to predictive maintenance and more. You will not only expand our current analytics capabilities but will help architect new strategies and applications within a dynamic innovative organization.

Upon completion of the program, successful consultants will join our global group of leading experts in operational excellence. We already have OEP graduates working at all levels of the firm, from associate to partner.

Your Qualifications and Skills


Bachelor's degree in engineering or business; Masters or other advanced degree preferred
Professional experience in procurement and/or supply management of services, contracts and categories and/or product development in the basic materials, consumer packaged goods, chemicals, financial services, healthcare, high-tech, oil & gas and energy industries
Passionate about operational excellence and driving transformational change in organizations
Outstanding analytical and conceptual skills
Initiative and creativity, working well both on your own as well as in a team
Comfortable with extensive travel
Skills to communicate complex ideas effectively, both verbally and written, in English and Spanish

Description

Customer retention and market expansion. This role provides end-to-end account and relationship support to our best customers, driving best practices and innovation to create more value for the business”. The goal is to increase customer satisfaction, retention and adoption of key product and service features within a particular market segment. 

Key Responsibilities

• Provide end-to-end, single point of contact support for our best customers – the As – from order entry and inquiry to AR support and issue resolution.
• Proactively anticipate customer needs and identify any potential opportunities or issues. Create recommendations and facilitate actions accordingly. (Requires a strong knowledge of the account, products, and daily interaction on a high level).

• Serve as the customers’ voice, including marketing, product, professional services and sales.

• Use customer benchmark data to highlight customers’ strategic success and provide ongoing recommendations for further optimization.
• Communicate and coordinate with internal departments (Product Managers/Sales Team/Marketing).

description:
About the job

Role highlights


Customer Excellence Specialist
Location: Mexico, Chile, or Colombia
Department: Customer Excellence
Reports to: Senior Customer Excellence Manager
Employment type: Permanent
Workplace model: Remote
Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)


Why this role matters

As a Customer Excellence Specialist, you’ll be the vital link between ICEYE’s SAR satellite capabilities and our customers across the LATAM region — ensuring every order, from submission to final delivery, runs smoothly and every customer interaction leaves a lasting impression.

Who We Are

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world’s largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

Your Day-to-day Responsibilities

Regular Customer Excellence Responsibilities

Order Management


Oversee the entire order process, from submission to the delivery of the final product.
Prepare comprehensive feasibility studies for satellite imagery, ensuring customer requirements are met.


Satellite Resource Planning


Plan satellite resources for capturing Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) images.
Perform SAR image quality control to maintain high standards.


Customer Interaction


Resolve customer inquiries and complaints promptly.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (satellite operators, sales, analytics, product software) to address project and customer-related issues.
Serve as a vital interface between clients and ICEYE, ensuring effective communication and interaction.


Process Improvement


Contribute to the enhancement of existing processes and documentation.
Report to management on key performance metrics and anomalies.


Product Knowledge


Maintain a thorough understanding of the company’s products, support, and services.


Account Management Responsibilities

Governmental and Commercial Contracts:


Serve as the point of contact for governmental contracts and commercial clients.
Conduct feasibility studies and effectively communicate results to customers.


Relationship Building


Build and maintain trusted relationships with customers, serving as a key contact for order-related queries.


Training And Progress Monitoring


Coordinate and conduct service training for both internal and external customers.
Monitor order progress closely, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues.


Reporting


Satisfy internal and external reporting needs by providing accurate Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).


What We’re Looking For


Bachelor’s degree in Geography, Remote Sensing, Aerospace, or a related field.
Proven experience in a customer excellence, account management, or customer-facing operations role.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills,Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Availability for shift work (no night shifts required).


Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

How We Work (Our Values)


Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.
Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.
See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.
Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.
Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.
Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.


Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us—we’ll do our best to help.

Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

Associate Consultant Intern, Marketing Services, Internship Program 2027 - Mexico City, Mexico

Associate Consultant Intern - 2027

At Mastercard, our Advisors & Consulting Services (ACS) group helps clients drive impact through data-driven insights, hands-on implementation, and a collaborative, tech-enabled culture. We invest in talent through global engagements, continuous learning, and programs like the Global Ambassadors Program, while fostering purpose through volunteerism, pro-bono work, and innovation that benefits both clients and communities.

Make an Impact as an Associate Consultant Intern

As an Associate Consultant Intern, you will collaborate within small teams to help some of the world's biggest brands answer and implement solutions for their most challenging strategic questions. You will immediately create meaningful contributions through taking ownership of deliverables and building external relationships with clients. Focusing on technology and data, you will gain broad exposure to a range of industries, including financial services, retail, restaurants, hospitality and more.

As An Associate Consultant Intern, You Will

We are looking for passionate and talented professionals, who share our vision for helping our customers with their most urgent business need. We are recruiting for four career tracks that make up our team. Marketing

Provide deep direct marketing expertise across channels, leveraging customer, behavioral and transactional data and defining tangible results to both the client and Mastercard.

How does a fintech client optimize new customer acquisition and existing customers’ life cycle value through effective targeting and communications?
How does a retail client drive foot traffic into store post-covid and/or optimize their ecommerce website to increase basket-size and average spend per customer?
How can a large financial institution best execute on a portfolio conversion – for example, after purchasing another issuer’s portfolio – including components like internal and external communications, market launch, and more?



Bring your Passion and Expertise

 Passion: Actively seeks responsibility and takes pride in delivering the highest quality results and recommendations to our clients. Proven record of leadership in a work setting and/or through extracurricular activities.

 Rapid Growth: Eagerness to learn quickly, both through Mastercard's structured training curriculum and organic development opportunities.

 Diverse Perspective: Brings a unique skillset or approach to the table in every client engagement or internal activity.

Exceptional analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills

How We Get Things Done…

,

Be part of the journey — Help shape our team through our referral program and enjoy a collaborative, social culture, backed by a transparent, performance-driven compensation framework that rewards impact and supports your growth.

The SAMY Mindset

Forget the job description for a second. The real question is: are you a Path Finder? Bold enough to challenge what's possible. Collaborative enough to build it together. Driven enough to make it happen.

We don't just hire for roles, we hire for mindset. We look for people who communicate with honesty, collaborate without ego, embrace change with energy, and take real ownership of what they build.

We're not looking for people who think the same, we're looking for people who want to grow with us.

Here's What It Actually Looks Like To Belong Here

Craft Together — because the best ideas don't happen in silos.

Enjoy the Journey — because growth lives outside the comfort zone.

If this feels like your kind of adventure, let's build something together.

Diversity & Inclusion

At SAMY, difference is not something we accommodate, it's what makes us stronger.

With a team made up of 70% women and more than 35 different nationalities, our different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences challenge our thinking, sharpen our creativity, and push us to build better work, and a better company.

description:
About the job

TikTok Shop Growth Manager




EVMT Brands | Remote | Full-time | 2,000-2,500/month USD + Performance BONUS

EVMT Brands makes liquid chalk, the grip product trusted by 250,000+ athletes across powerlifting, CrossFit, climbing, and calisthenics. Amazon is locked in. TikTok Shop is wide open. We need someone to light the fuse.




We are not looking for someone to manage tasks. We are looking for someone who has done this before, knows what a winning TikTok Shop affiliate program looks like, and can walk in on day one and build it. This is your chance to own the channel, own the results, and build something that matters.




You will take full ownership of the program. We currently run the channel through an agency; your job is to take it over and bring it fully in-house, with the agency supporting the transition.




What Winning Looks Like

Six months in: a creator army of quality affiliates posting regularly, average GMV per video climbing, fulfillment rates above 50%, and a GMV Max library that actually delivers. You will have built the outreach process, the content standards, the re-engagement system, and the weekly reporting cadence from scratch. The program runs because of you..




Your Playbook

One Thing:

Turn liquid chalk creators into a high-converting TikTok Shop sales machine.




Own These First:

Run targeted creator outreach in Euka across all creator tiers, prioritizing signals that predict performance: niche fit, engagement quality, and posting consistency. Volume matters, but the goal is creators who actually post and convert.
Build and enforce a content standard: every video in GMV Max has a hook in the first 3 seconds, a product demo, proof, and a CTA, no exceptions
Analyze performance data to identify growth opportunities, propose experiments, and build a roadmap to scale TikTok Shop profitably.
Keep creators engaged: re-engagement flows for non-posters, posting deadlines, follow-up DMs, and accountability
Drive GMV Max performance: improve delivery rate, average GMV per video, and overall affiliate-attributed sales month over month
Manage and hold external agencies accountable through KPIs, testing plans, and performance reviews.




Daily and Weekly Hustle:

• Run outreach campaigns, review performance, kill what is not working, scale what is

• Review every creator video before it enters GMV Max, approve, reject, or provide exact feedback and hook scripts

• Track the full sample funnel: applications, approvals, delivered, fulfilled, videos posted

• Report weekly to the founder with clean numbers and clear recommendations

• Own the creator CRM, accurate status on every creator at every stage




Who You Are

• You have built a TikTok Shop affiliate program before and have the results to prove it. We want to see numbers: before and after GMV, creator pool size, fulfillment rates.

• You have owned a channel or program yourself, not run one piece of it inside a bigger team. When you describe your results, "I" should be doing most of the work in the sentence, not "we".

• You have managed 100+ creator relationships simultaneously and kept them moving

• You understand TikTok GMV Max deeply: how the delivery algorithm works, what makes a video clear the bar, how to build a library that performs

• You have built outreach processes from scratch, not just inherited someone else's system

• You know what a good hook looks like and can write one yourself

• Experience with Euka, JoinBrands, or similar creator outreach platforms

• Strong written English for creator DMs, hook scripts, and briefs

• Data-driven: comfortable in Google Sheets and AI tools, clean data entry is non-negotiable

• You do not wait to be told what to do. You identify the problem and fix it.

• Detail-oriented with a structured process for A/B testing. Design and prioritize structured experiments across creator outreach, content angles, incentives, product selection, and GMV Max strategy.




Bonus:

• Background in fitness, sports, or health categories on TikTok Shop

• Experience working directly with founders or small teams




Work Setup

Remote, full-time (Philippines or Latin America preferred)
40 hours per week, Monday through Friday
US Pacific Time business hours overlap required
Full-time and exclusive: no concurrent clients or side projects
Start date: as soon as possible




Compensation

2,000-2,500/month USD + Performance Bonus tied to affiliate GMV




This role grows: we plan to launch our second brand on TikTok Shop and expand both brands to Meta and Instagram. Deliver on TikTok, and the role becomes social commerce across two brands, with compensation revised upward as scope grows.




Why EVMT

The product is proven. The Amazon business is real. TikTok Shop is the next chapter and it is wide open. You will have direct access to the founder, a real budget, and full ownership of the channel. No bureaucracy. No hand-holding. Just a big opportunity and the trust to run with it.

We are not filling a seat. We are finding the person who builds this.

Shortlisted candidates will receive four short written questions before any interview.

The Account Manager (what we call Client Solutions Manager (CSM)) will work closely with the sales team to provide support and expertise in meeting client objectives and providing best in class customer service to both internal and external clients. The CSM will be responsible for negotiating and optimizing complex opportunities and use data and analytics to build a consultative solution for our clients. They will establish and strengthen key client relationships with a focus on driving revenue, advertiser education & advertiser satisfaction. Success in this position requires a great focus on client service, ability to thrive in an ever-changing work environment, and provide custom solutions for advertisers leveraging our unique suite of ad products.

Responsibilities:
- Manage and grow client relationships with advertisers. This includes conducting regular business reviews and taking a consultative, seller approach to increase client investments, in collaboration with the Sales Team.
- Build trusted relationships with clients through world class service, as well as identifying and proactively recommending custom solutions and new market opportunities.
- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of TikTok features and trends, and serve as an external product expert, educating clients on new and existing TikTok ad solutions and advising on best practices to drive optimal performance and groundbreaking campaigns.
- Work closely with Technical Account Managers to organize, monitor and analyze campaign performance.
- Make proactive and data-driven recommendations to optimize advertising offerings and strategies to achieve sales targets.
- Collaborate with a diverse group of internal cross-functional teams including Ad Ops, Product and R&D to ensure successful campaign executions and troubleshoot client issues.
- Collect marketplace feedback and insights to guide our advertising strategy and ad offerings
- Work to manage custom marketing programs/sponsorships with other departments internally and lead the custom content campaigns to ensure assets are distributed and delivered on time.

- 5+ years of experience in account management/client services roles in digital marketing
- Experience working directly with brand or performance advertisers, and executing custom branded campaigns.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills, with ability to effectively translate technical language to non-technical stakeholders
- Experience in campaign management and setup
- Ability to analyze data and identify insights to assess campaign performance and provide recommendations.
- Experience with ad verification partners (IAS, DV, MOAT)
- High attention to detail, strong organizational skills, self-starter attitude, fast learner with critical thinking.

Preferred Qualification(s)

About the job

Job Description

About Us:

At Near, we help top talent in Latin America find remote roles with US companies. Our mission is to create better lives by fostering a remote work culture that transcends borders.

About Our Client

Our client is a U.S.-based e-commerce agency that manages and supports Amazon brands across a variety of consumer product categories, including apparel, skincare, sleepwear, beauty, food, jewelry, and other physical goods.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and lead a TikTok influencer product-seeding program across 10+ brands and product lines.
Identify, recruit, and manage relationships with TikTok influencers/creators at scale (aiming to build a network in the range of hundreds to 1,000+ creators).
Coordinate with the client to determine which products to gift, in what quantities, and for which campaigns.
Partner with the warehouse team to ensure gifted products are packed, shipped, and tracked accurately and on time.
Follow up with influencers to confirm receipt, prompt content creation, and curate/track submitted videos.
Build and refine a data-driven formula for gifting ROI (e.g., expected content yield and sales generated per X units gifted).
Put together business plans/break-even models for gifting campaigns, factoring in product cost, shipping cost, and expected sales return.
Track and report on campaign performance and influencer content quality across brands.
Leverage software and AI tools to streamline influencer discovery, outreach, and campaign tracking.
Serve as the primary client-facing point of contact for all things TikTok strategy and execution.







What We're Looking For




Genuine familiarity with and interest in TikTok — how the platform works, current trends, and influencer culture (deep prior professional experience is not required, as this is a new and evolving space)

Prior experience with influencer marketing, gifting/seeding programs, creator outreach, or affiliate-style marketing is a strong plus
Strong project management skills and the ability to juggle multiple brands, campaigns, and stakeholders simultaneously
Proactive, self-starter mindset — comfortable building a process where one doesn't fully exist yet
Basic business acumen: comfort thinking through cost, margin, and break-even math for gifting campaigns
Strong communication skills for regular, direct client interaction
Comfort using or learning software/AI tools for influencer discovery and campaign management
Fluent English required
Younger/digitally-native profiles are welcomed, given the emphasis on current platform fluency and trend awareness




Schedule and Work Arrangement




Full-time contractor position.
Remote within Latin America.
40 hours per week.
Flexible Monday-to-Friday schedule completed within the hours of 9:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. Eastern Time.
Tools include Amazon platforms, AI tools, Teamwork, and Jibble.

US holidays
Excellent and dynamic work environment

About the job

Descripción de la empresa Despacho Contable es una empresa dedicada a ofrecer servicios integrales de contabilidad, asesoría fiscal y administración a pequeñas y medianas empresas. title: Social Media & Operations Assistant
skills: Content Creation: Script, edit, and produce highly engaging short-form video and static content using CapCut and Canva (e.g., turning raw job site photos/videos provided by the owner into polished, branded marketing assets).
Calendar Management: Dedicate focused time daily (approx. 2 hours) to mapping out and building a structured social media content calendar.
Real-Time Marketing: Remain agile enough to deploy immediate, real-time posts based on weather events (e.g., launching targeted gutter marketing during heavy Florida rainstorms).
Community Engagement: Actively manage social media channels by handling posting schedules, replying directly to comments/DMs, and proactively driving online community engagement.
CRM Management: Step in to assist with backend tracking in the Jobber CRM platform—organizing client files, updating the status of unreached leads, and ensuring data integrity.
Administrative Coordination: Track incoming emails, locate documentation, and coordinate logistics like Certificates of Insurance (COIs) with the correct contacts.
SOP Utilization: Follow and help optimize existing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) already built out by the company to get up to speed quickly on internal workflows.
Task Prioritization: Actively monitor the business owner’s heavy workload and step in to help delegate, structure, and prioritize what needs his immediate focus.

Accountability: Maintain a confident, assertive communication style—unafraid to set firm deadlines for the owner (e.g., "Dustin, we need this approved by Wednesday afternoon, please prioritize this today").

Experience: 2–3+ years of proven experience in social media management, short-form video editing, or digital executive assistance. Experience supporting US-based home services or blue-collar industries is a massive plus.
Software Proficiency: High proficiency with Canva and CapCut (or professional-grade equivalent editing suites). A portfolio of past creative/video work will be required.

CRM Aptitude: Previous experience with Jobber (or comparable systems like ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro) is highly preferred, but not required. Comprehensive training will be provided for a candidate with high technical aptitude.
Cultural Context: Deep understanding of American consumer culture, idioms, and service market expectations.
Confident & Direct Communicator: A strong, vibrant personality who speaks up, handles objections gracefully, and is comfortable maintaining accountability with business leadership.
Independent Problem Solver: A right-brain creative who can also think logically on the backend; someone who connects the dots independently rather than relying on micro-management.
Bilingual Status: Fluent, accent-neutral English is strictly required. Native Spanish proficiency is a welcome bonus but is not a requirement for this role.

Full Time

SALARY

$1,300 – $1,500 / month

TARGET START DATE

ASAP




ROLE OVERVIEW




About the Client:




The company is a premier, locally owned, and BBB A+ rated home services provider based in North Florida, specializing in custom-fitted seamless gutter installations, premium micro-mesh leaf protection, repairs, and professional maintenance. Engineered to withstand severe subtropical rainfall and high-humidity climates, the business serves a wide residential and commercial client base across multiple counties.




Built on the concept of the "MVP Treatment," the company stands out through its absolute commitment to top-tier customer communication, doing things right the first time, and utilizing highly durable, premium materials. This dedication has earned them a reputation for stellar workmanship, trusted neighborhood reliability, and rapid regional growth.




About the Role:

The Client is seeking a proactive, highly creative, and exceptionally organized Social Media & Operations Assistant based in Latin America or South Africa to serve as a vital partner in daily operations.

We are moving away from traditional, passive agency models and looking to hire a true team member directly. This is not a passive "task-taker" role; we need a sharp, confident individual who takes absolute ownership of their domain and brings proactive solutions to the table rather than waiting for instruction.

The absolute highest priority for this role is creative social media management and content execution. Additionally, this individual will handle backend operations, lead tracking, and administrative coordination. Note: You will not be responsible for answering high-volume front-line phone calls (which are handled dynamically by an AI assistant and in-house staff). Instead, you will focus on content, backend workflows, and confidently managing the business owner’s priorities.




Key Responsibilities

🎨 Creative Social Media Management (Primary Focus)

Content Creation: Script, edit, and produce highly engaging short-form video and static content using CapCut and Canva (e.g., turning raw job site photos/videos provided by the owner into polished, branded marketing assets).
Calendar Management: Dedicate focused time daily (approx. 2 hours) to mapping out and building a structured social media content calendar.
Real-Time Marketing: Remain agile enough to deploy immediate, real-time posts based on weather events (e.g., launching targeted gutter marketing during heavy Florida rainstorms).
Community Engagement: Actively manage social media channels by handling posting schedules, replying directly to comments/DMs, and proactively driving online community engagement.

🗓️ Backend Operations & Lead Tracking

CRM Management: Step in to assist with backend tracking in the Jobber CRM platform—organizing client files, updating the status of unreached leads, and ensuring data integrity.
Administrative Coordination: Track incoming emails, locate documentation, and coordinate logistics like Certificates of Insurance (COIs) with the correct contacts.
SOP Utilization: Follow and help optimize existing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) already built out by the company to get up to speed quickly on internal workflows.

📈 Proactive Upward Management

Task Prioritization: Actively monitor the business owner’s heavy workload and step in to help delegate, structure, and prioritize what needs his immediate focus.
Accountability: Maintain a confident, assertive communication style—unafraid to set firm deadlines for the owner (e.g., "Dustin, we need this approved by Wednesday afternoon, please prioritize this today").




Ideal Candidate Profile

Experience & Technical Skills

Experience: 2–3+ years of proven experience in social media management, short-form video editing, or digital executive assistance. Experience supporting US-based home services or blue-collar industries is a massive plus.
Software Proficiency: High proficiency with Canva and CapCut (or professional-grade equivalent editing suites). A portfolio of past creative/video work will be required.
CRM Aptitude: Previous experience with Jobber (or comparable systems like ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro) is highly preferred, but not required. Comprehensive training will be provided for a candidate with high technical aptitude.
Cultural Context: Deep understanding of American consumer culture, idioms, and service market expectations.

Soft Skills & Cultural Fit

Confident & Direct Communicator: A strong, vibrant personality who speaks up, handles objections gracefully, and is comfortable maintaining accountability with business leadership.
Independent Problem Solver: A right-brain creative who can also think logically on the backend; someone who connects the dots independently rather than relying on micro-management.
Bilingual Status: Fluent, accent-neutral English is strictly required. Native Spanish proficiency is a welcome bonus but is not a requirement for this role.

title: Especialista de Marketing y E-commerce
description:
About the job

En Baking Alchemy desarrollamos soluciones innovadoras para la panadería y repostería profesional. Nuestro producto estrella es un aceite antiadherente de alto desempeño que facilita el engrasado y desmolde, ayudando a nuestros clientes a trabajar de forma más eficiente y consistente.




Formamos parte de Interlub Group, empresa mexicana con presencia internacional desde 1984, y de The Uncommon Lab, su plataforma de innovación enfocada en transformar conocimiento técnico en productos extraordinarios para el consumidor.




Buscamos a una persona creativa, analítica y orientada a resultados que impulse el posicionamiento y crecimiento de Baking Alchemy.




Tu misión




Construir una marca relevante, reconocida y cercana para profesionales y entusiastas de la panadería y repostería, integrando en una sola estrategia:




* Posicionamiento de marca.

* Trade marketing.

* E-commerce.

* Redes sociales y contenido digital.




La posición combinará estrategia y ejecución. Buscamos a alguien que pueda definir el rumbo de la marca, pero que también tenga la capacidad de implementar campañas, generar contenido, administrar canales digitales y activar los puntos de venta.




¿Qué harás?




Posicionamiento de marca




* Desarrollar y ejecutar la estrategia de marca de Baking Alchemy.

* Asegurar consistencia en mensajes, identidad visual y experiencia del cliente.

* Traducir la propuesta de valor del producto en comunicación clara y atractiva.

* Desarrollar campañas para aumentar el conocimiento, consideración y preferencia de marca.

* Identificar tendencias, audiencias y oportunidades de posicionamiento.




Trade marketing




* Diseñar activaciones, promociones y materiales para puntos de venta y distribuidores.

* Desarrollar exhibiciones, demostraciones y herramientas de apoyo comercial.

* Crear planes para incrementar rotación, recompra y visibilidad en tienda.

* Coordinar lanzamientos y campañas con el equipo comercial y los clientes.

* Medir el desempeño de promociones y acciones en punto de venta.




E-commerce




* Gestionar y desarrollar los canales de venta en línea de Baking Alchemy.

* Administrar catálogo, promociones, contenidos, inventarios y experiencia de compra.

* Implementar estrategias para aumentar tráfico, conversión, ticket promedio y recompra.

* Coordinar campañas de performance, marketplaces y automatizaciones comerciales.

* Analizar métricas y proponer mejoras continuas al embudo digital.




Redes sociales y contenido




* Crear y administrar el calendario de contenidos.

* Desarrollar publicaciones, campañas, videos, recetas y materiales educativos.

* Coordinar colaboraciones con chefs, reposteros, creadores de contenido y comunidades.

* Gestionar la interacción con usuarios y fortalecer la comunidad digital.

* Medir alcance, engagement, generación de demanda y conversión.




¿Qué buscamos?




* Licenciatura en Marketing, Comunicación, Publicidad, Negocios, Diseño o áreas relacionadas.

* Entre 3 y 6 años de experiencia en marketing, e-commerce, trade marketing o gestión de marca.

* Experiencia deseable en alimentos, productos de consumo, retail o Food Service.

* Manejo de redes sociales, plataformas de e-commerce, marketplaces y herramientas de análisis.

* Experiencia coordinando campañas digitales y acciones en punto de venta.

* Conocimientos de Meta Ads, Google Ads, CRM, email marketing y analítica digital.

* Inglés intermedio deseable.




Competencias clave




* Creatividad con enfoque comercial.

* Pensamiento estratégico y capacidad de ejecución.

* Sensibilidad por la marca y atención al detalle.

* Organización y seguimiento disciplinado.

* Capacidad para analizar datos y convertirlos en acciones.

* Mentalidad emprendedora y autonomía.

* Facilidad para colaborar con ventas, operaciones, agencias y proveedores.

* Afinidad con la gastronomía, panadería o repostería.




¿Cómo se verá el éxito?




* Mayor reconocimiento y preferencia de marca.

* Crecimiento sostenido del canal e-commerce.

* Incremento en tráfico, conversión, ticket promedio y recompra.

* Mayor visibilidad y rotación en puntos de venta.

* Comunidad digital activa y comprometida.

* Campañas comerciales medibles y alineadas con los objetivos de venta.

* Una identidad de marca consistente en todos los canales.




¿Qué ofrecemos?




* Sueldo competitivo y esquema de crecimiento.

* Autonomía para desarrollar la estrategia de marketing.

* Participación directa en la construcción de una marca en expansión.

* Capacitación continua y exposición a proyectos de innovación.

* Ambiente dinámico, creativo y colaborativo.

* Oportunidades de crecimiento dentro de Baking Alchemy, The Uncommon Lab e Interlub Group.




Buscamos a una persona que disfrute construir marcas, crear comunidad y transformar ideas en resultados comerciales.

About the job

Test Coordinator




We're looking for a proactive, community-minded professional to help run the day-to-day operations of our Game Tester platform. In this multi-faceted role, you'll support tester communities across Discord, email, and in-platform channels, review and refine test submissions to ensure quality standards are met, and act as a key point of contact for clients — guiding their testing requirements and helping troubleshoot issues when submissions fall short. You'll balance hands-on ownership with cross-functional collaboration, working closely with support, community, and client teams to keep testing running smoothly, testers engaged, and clients confident in the value we deliver.




Please note this is a temporary 6-month contract with possibility for extension or permanent employment.




What You Will Do:




Test Coordination

Review and test each submission for approval.
Monitor and manage live test invites.
Cooperate directly with clients to deliver the best results for their needs.

Manage and support testers during testing phases.

Community Management

Social Media

Scour social media looking for developers attempting to recruit for play tests to introduce ourselves.




Please note: This list is not exhaustive, and your day-to-day responsibilities will likely adapt and change over time depending on business needs and resources.




To Be Successful You Will Have:

1+ years experience with community management and/or coordinating events on schedule and within scope.
Outstanding communication and writing skills, including ability to ask questions or share information with clarity and brevity.
Fluency in English is mandatory.
Coordination skills, business acumen, and the ability to work with lots of moving pieces.
Passion about our customers, our technology, and our people.
Analytical/problem solving skills, demonstrated success in driving complex programs .
Be a motivated self-starter.




What Game Tester needs…

Our primary focus is on providing the best possible service to every developer and publisher that uses our platform. This has meant a never-ending review of our platform and processes. Always looking to improve the way things are done, reduce unnecessary workload and ultimately make the best possible platform for our partners.

We are a small team in a large organization where every single employee has a huge impact on the success of our platform. For this reason, we need self-starters and self-thinkers. Someone that can identify pain-points and propose solutions. You will need to be highly adaptable as our business grows and be willing to offer your support where it is most needed at all times.

You will be joining us for a roller coaster journey where your passionate commitment and contribution will be a key pillar in our long-term success, leading to many opportunities for growth in our business.

If you have what it takes, we would love to talk!

The opportunity to work with world-leading companies, opening the door to limitless opportunities.
Working with a Forbes-listed World-Leader in “Best Remote employer”, “Top employer of Women” and “Top employer for Diversity”.

Lionbridge Games help our customers deliver the seamless experience they envision to any audience around the world, without compromise. Our team of global gamers helps developers, publishers and platform-holders complete thousands of game audio, localization, testing and other player experience projects on time and on budget. Learn more at games.lionbridge.com.

description:
About the job

Overview

CAREERS TO SMILE ABOUT 

At PepsiCo, you’ll discover a place where our mission is to create smiles around the world. With a portfolio of more than 500 beloved brands including, Gatorade, Lay’s and Quaker, our work touches millions of people every day.

At the heart of the company is a team of thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who collaborate to innovate and turn ideas into action. Driven by innovation and a focus on creating joyful moments through food and drinks, our decisions are guided by consumer centricity, creating opportunities for our associates to do meaningful work and make a lasting impact in the communities we serve.

Whatever your role, you’ll be part of a global community that values your ideas and empowers you to make an impact, on your career and on the world around you.

Responsibilities

The Opportunity

The Jr. Content Designer is a specialist role focused on the creation and adaptation of print, digital, and motion content materials. This position requires a solid understanding of design principles and proficiency in creative software to develop high-quality visual assets.

The successful candidate will be responsible for producing production-ready graphics, supporting the development of creative concepts, and adapting existing brand assets to meet business, customer, and consumer needs. Working within established creative processes, the Jr. Content Designer will ensure all deliverables are visually compelling, aligned with brand guidelines, and executed with accuracy and consistency.

Your Impact

As a Jr. Content Designer, your responsibilities will include:


Support brainstorming sessions and contribute to concept development.
Design and execute low-complexity creative projects from concept to completion.
Create engaging visual presentations for internal Marketing initiatives.
Develop a variety of visual assets, including graphics, mockups, photo retouching, and other creative materials.
Adapt key visuals and existing brand assets for digital advertising, point-of-sale (POS) materials, and other consumer touchpoints.
Prepare print-ready artwork and production files as required.
Ensure all deliverables align with brand standards and maintain visual consistency across channels.
Manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining strong attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.
Incorporate feedback effectively and continuously improve creative, technical, and design skills.


Qualifications

Who Are We Looking For? 

Education


Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Digital Art, Visual Communication Design, or a related field.


Experience & Skills


1+ year of experience in a design role (agency or in-house environment preferred); recent graduates with relevant hands-on experience are encouraged to apply.
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop and Illustrator, with basic knowledge of print design and/or motion graphics.
Advanced English and Spanish communication skills, both written and spoken.
Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
Detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to learn and grow in a collaborative creative environment.


Portfolio


Portfolio should demonstrate design fundamentals across academic, personal, freelance, or professional projects.
Candidates should showcase projects that include multiple touchpoints, such as social media assets, POS materials, digital banners, or campaign adaptations.
The portfolio should reflect strong visual execution, attention to detail, and the ability to apply design concepts across different formats.
Experience working with consumer-facing brands is desirable.


 If this is an opportunity that interests you, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet 100% of the requirements.

Opportunities to learn and develop every day through a wide range of programs.
